goal: Deliver the requested macOS app, including live AI review and durable autosave/versioning
chosen: AppKit NSDocument/NSTextView editor and native toolbar/settings/history; bundled WebKit only for Markdown rendering; URLSession AI adapters; Keychain credentials
rejected: Browser app was an unauthorized product-surface assumption
Web-only wrapper would retain browser editing rather than a native editor
Third-party desktop shells add an unnecessary runtime
constraints: No localhost server required by the app
Do not overwrite existing app bundles
Only explicit Tab/button acceptance changes source
Autosave status follows successful atomic disk writes
Restore saves current content first and appends a new version
storage: Use FileManager's user Application Support URL plus the app bundle identifier; do not assume or report a path until resolved at runtime
circuit_breakers: Need destructive replacement of an existing app
Unsaved content lost in restore tests
Source snapshot differs from verified binary

ownership.codex: tools/markdown-studio/native, native docs/tests/build; required workflow records

verification: Swift core self-tests on temporary storage
Offscreen native UI + WebKit rendering check

requirements.FR-MD-6: Native macOS .app with source/rendered/split view, native file editing and AI settings
requirements.FR-MD-7: Debounced durable draft autosave and original-file autosave when saved, truthful errors, conflict detection
requirements.FR-MD-8: Immutable timestamped versions with preview, restore-as-new-version and reopening recovery
